newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-ITINERARY FOR FINAL ROUND OF CONCACAF WORLD CUP MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITINERARY FOR FINAL ROUND OF CONCACAF WORLD CUP MATCHES.

text.p: Itinerary for the final round of
CONCACAF World Cup qualifying matches issued on Monday:
Mar 2 - Mexico v Canada Mexico City
- Jamaica v United States Kingston
Mar 16 - United States v Canada TBA
- Costa Rica v Mexico San Jose
Mar 23 - Costa Rica v United States San Jose
Apr 6 - Canada v El Salvador Vancouver
Apr 13 - Mexico v Jamaica Mexico City
Apr 20 - United States v Mexico TBA
Apr 27 - Canada v Jamaica Vancouver
May 4 - El Salvador v Costa Rica San Salvador
May 11 - Costa Rica v Jamaica San Jose
May 18 - Jamaica v El Salvador Kingston
Jun 1 - Canada v Costa Rica Edmonton
Jun 8 - El Salvador v Mexico San Salvador
Jun 29 - El Salvador v United States San Salvador
Aug 10 - Costa Rica v El Salvador San Jose
Sept 7 - United States v Costa Rica TBA
- Jamaica v Canada Kingston
Sept 14 - Jamaica v Costa Rica Kingston
- El Salvador v Canada San Salvador
Oct 3 - United States v Jamaica TBA
Oct 5 - Mexico v El Salvador Mexico City
Oct 12 - Canada v Mexico Edmonton
Nov 2 - Mexico v United States Mexico City
Nov 9 - Canada v United States Vancouver
- El Salvador v Jamaica San Salvador
- Mexico v Costa Rica Mexico City
Nov 16 - Jamaica v Mexico Kingston
- Costa Rica v Canada San Jose
- United States v El Salvador TBA
Note: Top three teams qualify for the 1998 finals in France.
